LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Veteran_1: {PAWN} cleared a raider den squatting on an old Army depot and stripped it of anything Lost Hills could use.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Veteran_2: {PAWN} tracked down a rumored tech cache, fought off the ferals guarding it, and hauled out what was left intact.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the trip mapping an old highway network, marking safe routes back to the bunker.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back limping but standing, a busted pre-War terminal slung over one shoulder.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Elite_1: {PAWN} went in alone where a squad would've drawn too much attention, and came out the other side with the mission done.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the operation exactly as planned - in, secure the objective, out before anything organized a response.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks in hostile territory and returned with intel the Elder will want to hear.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what happened out there, just handed over the recovered tech and asked for a debrief later.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past the edge of any map the Western Chapter has, charting ground no Brother has set foot on in living memory.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from the unmapped wastes with a full report and coordinates worth the original Codex noting down.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks beyond contact and returned with word of something out there worth Lost Hills' attention.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_LostHills_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} walked back into the bunker looking like the wasteland itself, carrying proof of what was found at the edge of the map.
